name: Christopher Hudson
abstract_title: Time as a Trifecta of Consciousness, Change, and the Timeless
abstract: Resolution of the “hard problem” of consciousness has, in part, been stymied by insufficient progress with fundamental questions regarding the existence and nature of time. These involve diverse philosophical theories ranging from presentism to eternalism and the block universe theory of spacetime, including the growing universe, moving spotlight, and multidimensional models. field: Social work, time theory, consciousness, complex systems
notable: Author of 'Navigating Time' and 'Complex Systems and Human Behavior'; PhD from UIC
